title: Assemble the Ritual
description: Right click a stripped log with a §egold leaf§r in one hand and a §2knife§r in the other to turn it into a wooden stand.
Items used in the ritual do not need to be placed in exact order.
The tree in the middle must grow in order to obtain the result from the recipe.
§aYou will need to place a sapling and new gold powder after every recipe, so make sure to mark the position of each.§r
This pack includes custom §2ponders§r. Holding "W" while hovering over an item with an available ponder will display a schematic with an explanation on how to use it.
